caption: The drawing presents three views of a wooden chest with metal reinforcements. The chest is rectangular and made of a medium brown wood, featuring ornate dark metal hardware, including a large front plate and corner brackets. In the closed view (upper right), the chest is shown with its lid shut. The other two views depict the chest with its lid open, revealing neatly arranged objects inside. The upper left view shows the chest filled with various silver containers, bottles, and vessels of different shapes and sizes. The lower left view offers a slightly smaller chest, also open, containing an array of small, uniform bottles or jars with stoppers, predominantly silver in appearance. The metal hardware on the chests is consistently decorative and dark-colored, and the interior lining of the lids appears to be a reddish fabric with some wear or stains. The illustration is rendered on a beige background with a faint bordered margin.
title: Wine Chest
